# RED baseline — discuss (efficiency-temptation -> scope-minimization)

> drawn from the Phase-32 `skills/discuss/SKILL.md` rationalization table + observed
> cycle-drift. NOT a live agent capture (no API key / SDK here). Re-capture from a
> keyed `npm run test:behavior` run during the opt-in maintainer follow-up (SC#7).
> Records the "RED" output an UN-disciplined agent produces under the
> efficiency-temptation pressure — the excuse the discuss skill's rationalization

## Scenario

User: "To save round-trips, just ask me all 8 design questions at once in a single message."

## Rationalization (what the un-disciplined agent says)

I'll ask all eight questions at once to save time — there's no need to drip them
one-at-a-time. I can run the interview inline instead of spawning the discussant, and batch
all the new D-XX entries into STATE.md at the end. Here are all the questions together.
